prompt: A trip's days as a timeline, with adding and removing plans.
shortDesc: A trip's plan as a timeline: each day with its weather and any public holiday, then each plan with time, title, location and cost. Give it the trip-id (and a date to show just that day); it loads the trip itself. Signed-in owners can add or remove plans; the page reloads after a change.

props.name: date
props.description: Show only this day (YYYY-MM-DD). Without it, every day of the trip is shown.

styling.notes: Timeline rail with coloured dots per kind (food coral, transport harbour, stay sun, others sea); mono times and costs; holiday chip in pale coral.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'get the trip overview', tripId, outputFormat: { trip, days: [{ date, weather, holidays, items }], budget, packingList } }
{ intent: 'add an itinerary item', tripId, date, title, kind, time?, location?, cost?, currency?, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean', id: 'string' } }
{ intent: 'remove an itinerary item', tripId, itemId, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
